item.title: The Last Dry Seat

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy.

item.tests: Turns two described characters and a simple story into one assembled 15-second film with a readable setup, kind gesture and resolution.

answer_sheet.Characters: A young adult woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; an older adult man with a white beard and blue coat.
answer_sheet.Story and setting: A wet park bench; the woman finds it wet, the man offers his folded newspaper as a dry seat, then they sit together and smile.
answer_sheet.Length and format: One 15-second widescreen 16:9 video, with three scenes.
answer_sheet.Sound, dialogue and text: Silent, with no dialogue, captions or titles.

must_haves: One playable 15-second widescreen film contains three sequential scenes, not separate clip deliverables.
The woman has a curly black bob and yellow raincoat; the man has a white beard and blue coat.
The opening visibly establishes that the park bench is wet.
The man offers a folded newspaper as a dry place to sit, and the ending shows both characters seated together and smiling.
The film has a live-action appearance and no audible soundtrack.

args.name: A Kind Gesture at a Park Bench

style.prompt: A heartwarming cinematic scene in a leafy public park during a gentle rain. Two adult strangers sit on a wooden park bench: an older man without an umbrella, his coat damp, and a young adult woman holding a large yellow umbrella. In one simple natural gesture, the woman notices him and gently moves her umbrella over to shelter them both. He looks up and gives her a grateful smile; she smiles warmly back. Medium-wide eye-level shot, subtle slow camera push-in, realistic human movement, soft overcast light, glistening leaves, warm hopeful mood, consistent characters, one continuous shot, no text or captions.
